title: ORCA-bench: How Ready Are Language Model Agents for Oncall?
summary: ORCA-bench: How Ready Are Language Model Agents for Oncall?｜Large language models can write, patch, and search code, but oncall root cause analysis (RCA) demands something differen

extra.description: Large language models can write, patch, and search code, but oncall root cause analysis (RCA) demands something different: reasoning over noisy metrics, logs, traces, and source code, starting from ambiguous user-facing reports, often hours after the incident began. We introduce ORCA-bench, a benchmark that puts general-purpose coding agents in a production-fidelity oncall setting.
